people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
translations.bsb: Every day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they did not stop teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.
translations.kjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
translations.asv: And every day, in the temple and at home, they ceased not to teach and to preach Jesus as the Christ.
